input.quote: 10.2 No Joint Venture. The Parties agree that and acknowledge that the relationship of the Parties is in the nature of an independent contractor.
input.rationale:
We reviewed the whole agreement, including Section 5.4 (General Managers), the Section 6 exclusivity provisions and the Section 10 general provisions, and searched for "solicit", "employ", "hire" and "induce". The only employment-related references are incidental (HDI's employees in the confidentiality carve-out at p0051 and the independent-contractor language at p0061); there is no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binding the Company. This matches the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is warranted. The Section 6 restrictions are commercial exclusivity covenants rather than personnel restrictions and fall outside this rule.</rationale>
